title: avena strigosa subsp. brevis
intro: Avena strigosa subsp. brevis, commonly known as black oat, is a subspecies of oat plant (Avena strigosa) that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Avena strigosa subsp. brevis are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and antihistaminic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Avena strigosa subsp. brevis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and avenanthramides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
